checks: Color is always visible beside the wiring tools. Presets/custom picker color only newly completed cables; changing color while an origin is pending retains that origin and existing cables.
With a cable selected, the same visible color control edits only that cable, preserving endpoints and the next-cable color; Undo/Redo restore color changes.
Both toolbar states and the color palette fit seven desktop/tablet/mobile/landscape viewports; Escape closes palette and returns focus.
Cable colors survive practice save and reload.
Real mobile touch chooses a preset and mounts a cable of that color.
